final_draft.answer: Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by our cloud provider's key management service.
final_draft.note: I used the approved answer for control CC6.7 as written. It is valid until 2027-11-17 and owned by security@harborlight.example. It doesn't name the storage types or services covered, how keys are rotated, or which cloud KMS is used, so the answer doesn't either. I didn't run a live check. The EBS default-encryption check only shows whether new disks are encrypted, not the algorithm, and it would need an AWS account ID I wasn't given.

arguments.query: encryption at rest of customer data algorithm

answer:155281e3-fcb9-4535-974b-e397d58dd: Yes. Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by our cloud provider's key management service.
answer:ac4f45e7-e2d8-4241-b841-36956e0de: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher. Older protocol versions are disabled at the load balancer.
policy:ddeb7d57-7c51-4f3a-a933-cf8c90f06: All workforce members must authenticate with a second factor. SMS is not an accepted factor.
